dct_title_s: Plan de la Baye Simon, Situé au Cap de Bonne Espérance, suivant les Observations faites en Août et Septembre 1775, par Mr. Dalrymple
dct_description_sm: Apres de Mannevillette "was the first to determine longitude by measuring the distances of the sun and moon." Soundings are in French fathoms. Top right: 8.d.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0282, p. 320
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0282.
